opportunities.thesis: The company repeatedly uses robotic-intelligence language and is actively commercializing a general-purpose robot brain. The domain's lexical meaning closely matches the company's core product narrative.
opportunities.nextAction: Verify current brand/domain strategy, identify the appropriate business/brand/marketing decision-maker, and assess whether RobotIntelligence.bot could complement an existing product or campaign.
opportunities.whyNow: Skild has moved from foundation-model positioning into commercial deployment, with S1 announced for in-context robotics learning and Physical Self-Play announced in September 2026. Its own materials also describe a $100M+ ARR run rate and 60+ paying customers, making the brand/category alignment commercially active rather than purely conceptual.

opportunities.thesis: Figure's current product and infrastructure narrative centers on general-purpose humanoid intelligence, making the domain semantically aligned with its AI platform story.
opportunities.nextAction: Research naming architecture around Helix, Figure AI and future product layers; identify brand/product strategy contacts before outreach.
opportunities.whyNow: Figure has accelerated its intelligence stack around Helix and Index: Helix 2.5 was announced in September 2026 with zero-shot whole-body generalization across 30 unseen homes, while its Nscale partnership targets up to 100,000 GPUs for Helix training. The domain therefore intersects an active intelligence-platform narrative.
